title: AdvancedChatMacros Reforged
description: Bind chat actions and run macros (commands, copies, info) for AdvancedChat. Refurbished Minecraft 26.x version of DarkKronicle AdvancedChatMacros.
body:
# AdvancedChatMacros Reforged

AdvancedChatMacros binds chat actions to keys and reacts to messages.

> **Unofficial fork.** This is a community-maintained continuation of DarkKronicle's *AdvancedChat* suite (which its author archived), updated to **Minecraft 26.1 and 26.2** (Java 25). It is **not affiliated with, nor endorsed by, DarkKronicle**, and is distributed under the original project's MPL-2.0 license.

## Features

- Keybind macros (run commands, copy, send info, suggest) via Konstruct scripts
- Auto-respond to matched messages with .toml match filters
- Optional integration with AdvancedChatFilters Reforged

## Requirements

- Minecraft **26.1.x** or **26.2** on **Java 25**
- [Fabric Loader](https://fabricmc.net/) 0.19+, [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api), [MaLiLib](https://modrinth.com/mod/malilib) (sakura-ryoko 26.x builds)
- [AdvancedChatCore Reforged](https://modrinth.com/mod/advancedchatcore-reforged)

## Source & license

[GitHub](https://github.com/flyingfinger1/AdvancedChatMacros) · MPL-2.0 · original mod by DarkKronicle
